title: geum aleppicum var. glabricaule
intro: Geum aleppicum var. glabricaule, commonly known as white avens or smooth avens, is a flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Geum aleppicum var. glabricaule are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
